aziende.title: Companies
aziende.subtitle: Each company sees only its own sheets and people. The logo goes at the top of every printed sheet.
aziende.empty: No companies yet. Create the first one, then invite its administrator.
aziende.name: Company name
aziende.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {kb} KB. Transparent or white background: it goes at the top of the printed sheet and the PDF.
aziende.logoNone: No logo: the printed sheet shows the company name.
aziende.deactivateText: The company's people will no longer be able to sign in and their sessions end at once. The sheets stay.
aziende.reactivateText: The company's people will be able to sign in again.

error.name: Enter the company name (2 to 120 characters).
error.nameTaken: A company with this name already exists.
error.logoType: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
error.logoTooLarge: The logo is larger than 1 MB: make it smaller and try again.
error.logoCorrupt: This image cannot be read. Save it again as PNG or JPEG and try again.
error.logoMissing: Choose a file for the logo.
